scope: Autonomous heartbeat follow-up: ordered local template like-state persistence

observed_before: With cold SharedPreferences initialization, four concurrent mutations left likeCount=1 although the latest intent was likeCount=3.
A deliberately delayed first backing-store write allowed two updates to be active simultaneously; write completion was not serialized.
finding.warm_store_control: Ordinary warm-store cases passed before the fix. The observed regressions concern cold initialization and controlled asynchronous completion, not every concurrent call.
change: Enqueue synchronously before the first await, then initialize/read/modify/write and await backing-store completion in call order.
Pass only account-scoped key and normalized boolean/count to the private queue helper, avoiding retention of full templates and document builders.
Preserve best-effort error handling; later queued operations continue after a failed write.
Keep one tail future and clear it only when the completing operation still owns the tail. Add no persistent history, polling or cache.

checked: Latest toggle intent survives cold storage initialization.
Different template/account records and guest scope survive concurrent writes and reload from the backing store.
Delayed storage writes have peak active count one and retain both final records.
A failed write does not poison the queue; subsequent scoped updates and count normalization complete.
Queued closures hold scalar intent metadata only. Lazy documents are not generated.
Existing preference key/schema, server calls, optimistic behavior, account-generation guards, request sharing and merge/category fixes remain unchanged.

concurrent_workspace_changes.action: Observed external modification during this run; did not edit or revert it.

next_candidates: Review detail like-button submission locking around asynchronous account resolution under rapid clicks and route close.
Main album/reader hidden-resume photo preparation and failure recovery, checking concurrent work/recent reports before editing shared files.

limits: Ordering applies within the app isolate; this is not a cross-process or cross-isolate transaction.
Platform storage failures remain best-effort as before, with no retry loop or new durability guarantee.
Real device frame timing, native memory and storage internals were not profiled.
